title: Attention-optimizer transition — onboarding eval playbook and diff scan
content:
Summary:
This doc captures the onboarding evaluation playbook and a focused diff-scan for transitioning attention/kernel codepaths (attenix v2) alongside Paged-KV and Continuous-Batching (CB) interactions. The goal is to produce a repeatable checklist for model onboarding when changing attention kernels and to archive observed regressions or behavioral deltas across prompt sets used during model onboarding.

Background / motivation:
- Recent kernel change (attenix v2) claims 25–40% lower p50 latency for long contexts but rewrites memory layout and attention math optimizations.
- Paged-KV is being rolled out to reduce peak GPU memory for long-context workloads; CB heuristics were changed in late-2025 to be more aggressive on short bursts.
- Early internal smoke runs flagged a few instruction-following regressions on coding prompts and higher stop-rate on some assistant prompts. Need systematic onboarding tests to catch regressions before model rollout.

Scope of this doc:
- Models: primary onboarding tracked on rw-infer/falcon-7b-v2-pin and rw-infer/rlhf-7b-chat-2025-12.
- Kernels: baseline = flash-attn-legacy (flashx), candidate = attenix-v2.
- Secondary features: paged-KV (pagedkv-v1) on/off, continuous-batching enabled/disabled (CB-v3 heuristics).
- Prompt sets: instruction-following (IF), conversational assistants (ASSIST), code-completion (CODE), summarization (SUM), safety/edgecases (SAFE).
- Eval metrics: ROUGE-L (where applicable), model perplexity on heldout, stop-rate (premature EOS), answer-accuracy on small curated tasks (QA microbenchmarks), latency p50/p95, token-cost delta, and hallucination score (human-labeled subset).

Test matrix (short):
- 2 models x 2 kernels x 2 pagedKV x 2 CB = 16 combos. For each combo we run 5 prompt suites (IF, ASSIST, CODE, SUM, SAFE).
- Run sizes: lightweight warmup (100 prompts per suite) + full sweep (2k prompts per suite) for flagged combos.

Repro recipe (for engineers onboarding a new model):
1) Check out branch from PR linked (GH #3120) and build kernel image (build-2026-01-15-attenix-v2).
2) Start a controlled serving cluster with single-GPU workers, disable autoscaling to keep capacity stable.
3) Run baseline (flashx + pagedkv off + CB off) on the 100 prompt warmup to sanity check.
4) Switch only the kernel (attenix-v2) and rerun warmup. Capture diffs.
5) Toggle pagedKV on, rerun. Then toggle CB heuristics.
6) For any delta beyond thresholds (see thresholds table below) escalate to eng-sre+applied-ml.

Acceptance thresholds for automated gating:
- Latency: p95 increase > 15% => fail
- Stop-rate: absolute increase > 2.5 percentage points on IF and ASSIST suites => fail
- ROUGE-L (summarization): drop > 3 points absolute => human review
- Accuracy (QA microbench): drop > 4% absolute => fail
- Hallucination sample: any new high-severity hallucination on SAFE suite => fail and manual triage

Top-level results snapshot (warmup 100 prompts/suite, model=rw-infer/falcon-7b-v2-pin):
- attenix-v2 vs flashx (pagedKV off, CB off):
  - latency: p50 -22% (win), p95 -8% (win)
  - stop-rate: +0.6pp on ASSIST, +0.1pp IF (within noise)
  - CODE suite: minor truncation increase on multi-line completion: # of truncated responses +1.3% (investigate)
  - QA microbench: accuracy -0.8% (within threshold)
  - Summarization ROUGE-L: -0.4 (no action)
- attenix-v2 + pagedKV-v1 (CB off):
  - latency: p50 -18%, p95 -12%
  - memory: GPU peak -28% (expected win)
  - stop-rate: ASSIST +2.9pp (FAIL threshold hit)
  - human checks: 3 instances where assistant answer truncated mid-sentence leading to abrupt termination on follow-ups
- attenix-v2 + pagedKV-v1 + CB-v3 (aggressive):
  - latency: p50 -25%, p95 -14%
  - stop-rate: ASSIST +4.1pp (worse)
  - CODE: multi-line completions truncated more often (+3.9%) and more malformed JSON outputs in structured-output prompts
  - QA accuracy: -3.6% (near threshold)

Detailed per-suite notes (examples):
- ASSIST (notable):
  - Prompt sample ID A-714: baseline returned a 4-paragraph reply with follow-up question; attenix+pagedKV returned 1.5 paragraphs then EOS token (user follow-up broken). Root cause hypothesis: pagedKV eviction boundary combined with CB heuristics occasionally flushes KV state earlier causing decoder to believe sequence complete.
  - Logged stack traces show token-id 50256 emitted at different step in attenix run (off-by-one in EOS detection?)

- CODE (notable):
  - Prompt C-1022 (python function extension): attenix+pagedKV+CB produced truncated closing braces, leading to invalid code (tests fail). Reproduction locally with max_new_tokens up to 512 shows problem correlated with KV page boundary alignment.

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Paged-KV page boundaries with attenix memory layout cause occasional off-by-one in KV index mapping => premature EOS or truncated outputs.
2) CB-v3 aggressively forces state flush for short bursts; combined with pagedKV this increases likelihood of missing prefix cache pieces for long-context assistant prompts.
3) attenix-v2 math or numerics change slightly alters token probabilities near EOS, increasing stop-rate marginally in some prompt distributions.

Quick triage experiments to run (priority order):
- Re-run failing ASSIST prompts with pagedKV page-size increased by 25% (config flag: pagedkv.page_size_ratio) and observe stop-rate delta.
- Disable CB heuristics (force per-request batching) while leaving pagedKV on to isolate CB interactions.
- Instrument KV page boundary emit logs (add ephemeral trace flag KV_BOUNDARY_TRACE=1) for the failing prompts and correlate with EOS token emission timestamp.
- Run a micro-benchmark: replay problematic CODE prompts with controlled prefix lengths and inspect last 64 token logits for EOS probability spikes.

Human audit findings (sample of 50 flagged outputs):
- 12/50 truncated assistant responses (severity: medium)
- 6/50 malformed code completions (severity: medium-high for CODE suite)
- 2/50 hallucination increases flagged on SAFE suite (severity: high) — both are historically sensitive privacy prompts; examples attached in GH issue.

Immediate mitigation options (short-term):
- Rollback to flashx for the affected model until attenix+pagedKV combo is fixed (recommended if in production path).
- If rollback not possible: disable pagedKV for this model / customer tier and keep attenix-v2 to preserve latency wins on shorter contexts.
- Conservative CB config: set CB to less aggressive heuristics for models onboarded with attenix and pagedKV.

Longer-term engineering work (owners suggested):
- eng-applied-ml + serving-runtime: add unit tests that simulate page boundary misalignment with synthetic token streams (owner: Priya, linked INF-1452).
- runtime infra: expose KV boundary debug mode to staging clusters; schedule 48h run with production-like load (owner: Liam).
- research: probabilistic analysis of EOS probability shifts introduced by attenix numerics; consider tiny calibration pass for EOS logits (owner: Marco).

Open questions / notes to follow up:
- Is the off-by-one real in attenix or surfaced only when pagedKV is enabled? (test to isolate pagedKV).
- Do other models (rlhf variants) show the same pattern? Early signs show RLHF chat model has smaller delta but still measurable on CODE suite.
- Should we add an automated gating job to the model onboarding pipeline that runs the 1000-sample sweep with pagedKV on + CB on for every kernel change? (ops cost tradeoff)

Action items (next 7 days):
- [ ] Priya: create a reproducible unit test for KV boundary alignment (due 2026-02-05). Linked: INF-1452.
- [ ] Liam: spin up KV_BOUNDARY_TRACE staging and run 24h collection for the failing model (due 2026-02-04).
- [ ] Marco: run per-token EOS-prob drift analysis for the CODE prompt set and share notebook (due 2026-02-06).
- [ ] Asha: prepare short rollback plan & communication blurb for product/CS in case customer impact grows (due 2026-02-03).

Appendix: quick reproduction snippets
- curl example to reproduce a single prompt against staging with KV trace:
  curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate \\
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer STAGING_TOKEN' \\
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
    -d '{"model":"rw-infer/falcon-7b-v2-pin","kernel":"attenix-v2","pagedkv":"on","cb":"v3","trace":"KV_BOUNDARY_TRACE=1","prompt":"<PROMPT_HERE>","max_new_tokens":256}'

- Local run (python) to dump logits for last 64 tokens (snippet in linked GH PR).

Notes to reviewers:
- This doc is intentionally pragmatic / checklist-driven. Expect additional raw outputs in GH artifacts (PR 3120) and the JIRA ticket INF-1452.
- We should centralize failing prompt IDs into the onboarding artifact bucket: s3://redwood-onboarding/attenix-v2/failures/

If you are triaging this: mention me in #applied-ml with the prompt-id and the kernel config string and we will prioritize.
